name: Puni Mo☆E~ru! ~Sensei, Shimasho♪~
original_name: ぷにも☆え～る！～せんせぃ、しましょ♪～
source:
Main character is a tutor hired to teach three girls during summer vacations. However, he is not an ordinary tutor who teaches maths or English. He rather helps to overcome students' weak points and get them interested in the study process.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名家庭教师，暑假期间受雇辅导三名少女。不过，他并不是只教数学或英语的普通家教，而是帮助学生克服各自不擅长的事物，引导她们对学习本身产生兴趣。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
